rule.statement: A Petitioner or Appellant must name all necessary parties as Respondents to their Petition to ensure due and proper dispensation of justice.
rule.supporting_quote: Thus, it is evident that, Rule 28 (5) of the Supreme Court Rules, 1990 is an important provision of procedural law designed to ensure the due and proper dispensation of justice by this Court.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Rule 28 (5) of the Supreme Court Rules, 1990
